name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck kitchen orders
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the signal disappears. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service on.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen is able to prepare, then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU WON'T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches what the kitchen can do.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE WINDOW
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what is next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs to be started.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen ticket printer over Bluetooth or over the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DISAPPEARS
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection is interrupted, ordering in advance is paused so nobody places an order you won't see. Orders taken on the device are kept and sync when you are online again.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once, then take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for people who run food trucks and their staff. To sign in, you need a HatchGrab account.
